_about: The first paid picture: does the key work (organization verification), does the edits endpoint take a reference, what does a reference cost in image input tokens, and does the style carry over? Medium quality at the scene size: about a cent of output tokens.

items.label: Test: the zócalo
items.prompt: The zócalo (main square) of Puerto Colibrí on a sunny late morning. In the middle distance, a little right of center, the kiosco: an octagonal stone bandstand with a few steps, slender green wrought-iron columns and railing, and a red-tiled dome with a small lantern on top. Behind it, across the square, the parroquia: a simple lime-washed colonial church in white and ochre with an arched wooden door and a bell gable with two bells. Strings of colorful papel picado run from the kiosco's eaves to the lampposts; coconut palms and a big shady laurel tree; low painted buildings with arcades along the sides; pigeons on the pale stone paving. In the left third, in the foreground, an empty green wrought-iron bench in the shade of the tree.
